mainHero.description: Build your list, shop without a signal, and see what every trip actually cost. No more pencil and paper.

product.title: The real app
product.description: Every screen below is SavyCart doing its job — lists you can search, history you can sort, totals you can trust.

items.title: Your list, searchable and starred
items.description: Find any product in seconds, star the staples you always buy, and keep brands, units, and prices in one place.
items.alt: SavyCart product list with search, favorites, and prices

items.title: Every trip, remembered
items.description: Each shopping run is saved with the store name, date, and total — so you can compare visits and spot where spending creeps up.
items.alt: SavyCart shopping history with place, date, and total price

items.title: Prices over time, per product
items.description: Open any item to see what you paid on each date. Watch fluctuations before you buy, and make smarter choices at the shelf.
items.alt: Purchase history modal showing product prices across dates

features.title: What changes when you switch
features.description: Four things SavyCart does that a note in your pocket never will.

items.sentence: Star the staples you always buy
items.consequence: Favorites filter puts your regulars at the top of every list.
Offline support — your list stays on the device in the aisle.
Checkout totals include tax so the receipt never surprises you.
Place, date, and total saved for every shopping run you finish.

howItWorks.title: Three steps
howItWorks.description: From an empty list to a clear picture of your spending.

steps.responseLabel: Products land with unit and price
Quantity, subtotal, and tax at checkout
Place, date, and total — saved forever

finalCta.title: Start your next list
finalCta.description: Free on iPhone and in the browser. Your history syncs when you are online.

about.title: Made for real shopping trips
about.description: SavyCart is an open-source PWA and iOS app for tracking personal purchases. It replaces the notebook in your pocket with a list that remembers prices, keeps your history, and works offline in the aisle.
